text: Nde woondoore maɓɓe, wanaa e annuyee moƴƴo, ko e mawnintinaare ka hoore leydi tun, e ɗaynugol yimɓe ɓen. Hara non, pewje bonɗe ɗen huuɓitataa, si wanaa jom-mun'en. Hara hiɓe sabbitii si wanaa laawol Alla ngol e adinooɓe ɓen, ngol woni halku-gol ɓe? A heɓantaa laawol Alla ngol e halkugol townitiiɓe ɓen, ngosttiigu, naɓtira e woɗɓe goo, wanaa waylirɗum kadi itta e maɓɓe.
